```ts
import type { ArcRotateCamera } from "@babylonjs/lite";

export function focusOn(camera: ArcRotateCamera, point: { x: number; y: number; z: number }): void {
    camera.target.x = point.x;
    camera.target.y = point.y;
    camera.target.z = point.z;

    // Note 3: target changes are not visible until the next alpha/beta/radius
    // write that changes the value. Nudge alpha to force a rebuild, then
    // restore it so the angles are unchanged.
    const a = camera.alpha;
    camera.alpha = a + 1e-10;
    camera.alpha = a;
}
```
